headline: Claude agent skills enforce coding standards across distributed development teams
body: Anthropic's Claude is gaining capability to enforce team coding standards through agent skills, addressing a persistent challenge in multi-developer environments. For healthcare AI systems, this matters because clinical-grade code requires consistent standards across teams building EHR integrations, diagnostic algorithms, and compliance-critical workflows. Standardized code reduces security vulnerabilities, improves maintainability during audits, and accelerates onboarding for healthcare developers unfamiliar with domain-specific patterns. Healthcare vendors and consultants deploying Claude for internal tool development can now enforce HIPAA-aligned practices and clinical coding conventions automatically, reducing manual review cycles and human error in regulated environments.
